newsitem.title: INDIA: India 97/98 budget vote expected in late April.
newsitem.headline: India 97/98 budget vote expected in late April.

text.p: The Indian parliament is expected to begin debating the 1997/98 (April-March) budget next week but no vote is anticipated until late April, parliamentary officials said on Wednesday.
The government will ask lawmakers to approve a stop-gap budget, called a vote on account, before parliament begins a month-long recess set to start on March 21, they said.
The temporary budget would authorise the continuation of government programmes until the full-fledged budget is passed.
The 1997/98 budget, which Finance Minister P. Chidambaram presented to parliament on February 28, is expected to come to a vote after lawmakers resume work on April 21.
Parliamentary officials said they expected a vote during the last week of April but said it could be delayed.
